title.purpose: Service names, stylist names, drawer titles, the phone number.

label.purpose: Small sentence-case labels inside a section; never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: sleeve-rim

shadows.name: nav-scrolled
shadows.purpose: Nav lift once the page scrolls.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Booking drawer and menu from the right.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Drawer as a bottom sheet under 640px.

shadows.name: nav-material

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: All travel: buttons, reveals, drawers, record.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.value: transform 550ms ease-house; translateY(-2px) hover, scale(0.97) active 90ms

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal; content visible without JS.

motion.name: record-out
motion.value: translateX(-38%) to 0, 1400ms ease-house, 300ms delay; then rotate 360deg every 14s linear

motion.name: record-peek
motion.value: translateX(34%), 700ms ease-house on hover/focus, or when the sleeve snaps into place on touch

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: Booking drawer and menu; sheet rises from below on phones.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no travel; opacity-only fades 200 to 400ms; record still, half out

narrative.overview:
Haven Lofts is drawn as its own 1970s living room, built from the salon's real materials laid down as big flat fields: mustard velvet, olive wall, walnut, cognac leather. Each section of the page is one of those fields, edge to edge, and the real salon photos sit on them like album covers in rounded sleeves with a cream rim. A black record with a mustard label is the one decorative object; it slides out of the hero sleeve and peeks out of the room sleeves.

Density is low and the scale is big: one huge Gloock headline per section, a short paragraph, pills. Nothing is drawn on top of the rooms; the real photos and the flat colour carry the mood. The system rejects the cream-and-serif salon template and the darkened-photo "BOOK NOW" hero.

Light and dark both ship. In the evening theme the cream rooms go espresso while the mustard, olive and walnut fields stay themselves, a shade deeper.
keyCharacteristics: Whole sections are flat colour fields: mustard (hero, stylists, visit), olive (the space), cognac (services), walnut (spray tan), espresso (footer).
Photos are sleeves: 28px corners and a 10px cream rim.
One signature stripe (cognac, walnut, olive with thin cream rules) placed once inside each major section.
One display face, one text face; pills for every action.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: A section is one flat field of one material colour, edge to edge. Do not tint, gradient or overlay a field.

rules.name: The Espresso On Mustard Rule
rules.body: Anything set on mustard (labels, nav links, icons, focus rings) uses espresso ink. Walnut text on mustard failed contrast.

rules.name: The Cream Price Rule
rules.body: On the cognac services field, prices and body text are cream (5.29:1 light, 7.10:1 dark). Gold-light on cognac is 4.25:1 and fails; never use it for text there.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Gloock for display, Albert Sans for everything else, nothing else.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case, never tracked capitals, and never sit above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Stripe Placement Rule
rules.body: The stripe runs once per major section, inside it (behind a sleeve, or bleeding off one side), never as a section border or divider.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons and fields carry no drop shadow. Only the nav (once scrolled) and the drawers lift.

dos: Do fill whole sections with one material colour (mustard, olive, walnut, cognac, espresso) and keep mustard on at least a third of the page.
Do set every photo as a sleeve: 28px corners and the 10px cream rim.
Do use espresso ink for all text and focus rings on mustard, and cream for text and prices on the cognac field.
Do spell the owner's name "Sara", never "Sarah".
Do use only the salon's real photos from `public/photos/`.
Do put `data-cta` on every Book button and route every booking through the booking drawer (call, text, or the stylist's own booking link).
Do ship both themes, and honour reduced motion (no travel, record still and half out), reduced transparency (solid mustard nav) and higher contrast (outlined ghost and icon buttons, ruled nav).
Do use the house ease `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` for movement.
donts: Don't use renders or AI images, and never show the bathroom.
Don't invent hours, prices or reviews.
Don't set gold-light text on the cognac field (4.25:1), or walnut text on mustard.
Don't use any face besides Gloock and Albert Sans.
Don't use the stripe more than once per section or as a border or divider.
Don't put tracked uppercase kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't draw decoration over the rooms (ivy, pendants, candles, neon script); the real photos and the fields carry the mood.
Don't darken a photo behind a headline for the hero.
